items.decision: Only overflow-checks-on emissions named in PCQC_COVERAGE.json / PCQ_E037-E040: PCQ_E037 (aspis-core checked_field, Types), PCQ_E038 (aspis-core field Funs), PCQ_E039 (aspis-statement payment_relation), PCQ_E040 (pair_terminal), PCQC_E023 (adapter_owned_b Types). PCQC_E011 and the other PCQC dirs were read for External-template lookups only. Superseded PCO_E002 / PCO_E004 and every overflow-off emission were not used. No definition of this cluster appears in the PCQC p2_emission_dirs_per_gate_module map (it has no RPu_/RPv_ key); the emissions above were found by Rust-path presence (crate prefix ignored) and each equality is checked by Lean, so a wrong pairing yields a Lean failure, never a false equality.

items.topic: crate mismatch between gate and fresh emissions
items.decision: The gate modules name the crate aspis_r1_mask_extraction_probe (not part of the frozen tree); fresh emissions name aspis_core / aspis_statement. The compared definitions carry identical Source: line ranges (field.rs 19:0, 62:4-88:5, 94:4-119:5, 183:4-185:5, 860:0-866:1; format.rs POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH) and identical normalized bodies, so the theorems are statements about the fresh frozen function versus the gate constant; they do not say that the probe crate equals the frozen crate for any other item.

RPu_FIq_NativeTypes is flagged compiled_source_ambiguous; all candidate paths of every cluster module have one sha256 (inputs/gate_sources.json). Self-copy controls (candidate text with its namespace renamed as the fresh emission, statements against the compiled gate constants): NativeTypes 30 of 30 proved, Native11 8 of 8, Native01 34 of 38. The four Native01 control failures (PreparedQm31Multiplier.mul and its closure call, qm31_sum_products3_prepared_loop0 and loop0_loop0) are deterministic whnf heartbeat timeouts at the default 200000 (the gate source has no maxHeartbeats header) on text-identical sides; they are not body differences and were not rerun with a raised limit. They are outside the compared set (no fresh counterpart).
items.reason: PCO_HANDOFF section 4 self-copy control; no raised heartbeats

items.topic: generator change: structures with Array field types
items.decision: A structure whose field types mention only reducible alias types of the same file (field.M31 := Std.U32 on both sides, proved equal by rfl in the same bundle) now gets a generated Equiv with fields copied directly. Lean elaboration of the Equiv is the check. Before this change those structures were TEXT_IDENTICAL_ONLY.

items.decision: M31.ZERO/ONE/mul/reduce_u64 and QM31.mul have a fresh form only as External-template axioms (opaque) in the usable cost-probe emission PCQC_E011; the gate has its own Aeneas-translated definition. No equality is possible. Recorded in PCUB_HAND_MODELS.json with resolved_as_hand_written_model false (the gate definition is an Aeneas translation of the probe crate, not hand-written).

201 reached definitions have no same-Rust-path declaration in any usable fresh emission. These are not entries of the P1 failure list (PCQC_FAILURES.json): no spec exists for them. PCO_extract_specs.json routes the modules to cut specs C001 (crate unknown) and C005 (aspis_r1_mask_extraction_probe, NativeTypes) with route P4, and PCWB_CUT_TRIAGE.json found nothing by name. The Rust items exist in the frozen tree for 182 of the 201 by a name heuristic (PCUB_EQ_STATUS frozen_source), so a frozen spec could be written; 16 items were not found by name (closures, trait impls, and the probe-only helpers external_linear_lazy_row and array_from_fn_copy, confirmed absent from crates/ at 4bb3b3f5 by git grep) and 3 are core items. This job ran no extraction (budget 0).
